repository.name: Calcium Mock Repository
repository.description: Offline fixture repository used for development, testing, and desktop simulation.

apps.name: RetroArch
apps.author: Libretro Team
apps.description: Multi-system emulator frontend with shader support.
apps.long_description: RetroArch is a frontend for emulators, game engines and media players. It enables you to run classic games on a wide range of computers and consoles through its slick graphical interface. Settings are also unified so configuration is done once and for all. RetroArch has advanced features like shaders, netplay, rewinding, next-frame response times, and more.
apps.changelog:
- Updated cores to latest versions
- Improved controller mapping
- Fixed audio sync on PAL titles
- Added new shader presets

compatibility.notes: Works on all supported firmware versions.

apps.name: PSXitArch Linux
apps.author: PSXitArch Team
apps.description: Run a full Linux environment directly on your PS4.
apps.long_description: PSXitArch brings a complete Arch Linux environment to the PS4. It provides a lightweight desktop with terminal access, package management via pacman, and support for running Linux applications. Requires an external USB drive with at least 8 GB of free space.
apps.changelog:
- Updated base system packages
- Improved GPU driver compatibility
- Added Wi-Fi configuration utility

compatibility.notes: Requires USB storage device. Firmware 11.00 has known graphics driver issues.

apps.name: PCSX2 PS2 Emulator
apps.author: PCSX2 Team
apps.long_description: PCSX2 is the leading PlayStation 2 emulator. This homebrew port brings full PS2 compatibility to the PS4. Load your own legally dumped PS2 game backups and enjoy upscaled graphics, widescreen patches, and improved performance over original hardware.
apps.changelog:
- Improved compatibility with 1800+ titles
- Fixed hang on startup for PAL region games
- Better multitap controller support

apps.name: VSH Menu
apps.author: xmb5
apps.description: In-game overlay menu for system tweaks and app management.
apps.long_description: VSH Menu provides an in-game overlay accessible via a button combo that allows you to manage running applications, apply system tweaks, adjust fan speed, and view system statistics without leaving your current app or game.
apps.changelog:
- Added fan speed control
- Fixed overlay rendering on HDR displays
- New system info panel

apps.name: PS4 FTP Server
apps.author: hippie68
apps.description: Simple FTP server for transferring files to and from PS4.
apps.long_description: PS4 FTP Server starts a lightweight FTP daemon on your PS4 that allows you to browse the filesystem and transfer files over your local network using any FTP client. Supports both active and passive mode, directory listings, and file uploads.
apps.changelog:
- Passive mode fix for NAT environments
- Increased transfer speed by 40%
- Added IPv6 support

apps.name: PPSSPP
apps.author: Henrik Rydgard
apps.description: PSP emulator — play your PSP titles in HD on PS4.
apps.long_description: PPSSPP is a high-performance PSP emulator. This PS4 port enables you to play legally obtained PSP titles with enhanced resolution, texture filtering, and controller remapping. Most titles run at full speed or better.
apps.changelog:
- OpenGL renderer improvements
- Fixed stuttering in high-detail scenes
- Save state compatibility fixes

apps.name: Homebrew Browser
apps.author: Calcium Project
apps.description: Lightweight web browser for PS4 homebrew environments.
apps.long_description: A minimal but functional web browser built on WebKit that runs in the PS4 homebrew environment. Supports HTTP/HTTPS, bookmarks, and basic media playback. Intended for accessing documentation and lightweight web content.
apps.changelog:
- Initial public release
- HTTPS support
- Bookmark manager
- Basic media player

apps.name: PS4 Media Player
apps.author: mediateam
apps.description: Play MKV, MP4, FLAC, and more directly from USB or network.
apps.long_description: A full-featured media player for PS4 based on a libmpv port. Supports a wide range of video and audio codecs including H.264, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1, FLAC, and AAC. Plays files from local USB storage or a networked media server via SMB.
apps.changelog:
- AV1 hardware decode support
- SMB share browser
- Subtitle track selection improvements
- Fixed seek precision on H.265 content
